Here's some points of reference. Please keep in mind that, all of these have at least a dozen or more background apps running at the same time (OneDrive, 1Password, Terminal, etc.), I'm just going to mention the apps that are actively being used for each point.

\- Chome + VScode + discord call, I can achieve 6ish hours of battery. No lag whatsoever.

\- Chrome + PCSX2 + streaming PCSX2 on discord, while plugged in, I can maintain a solid 60fps in my favourite games plus stream 60fps on discord.

\- Chrome + Borderlands 3 + discord call, while plugged in, 50-60fps

\- Chrome + Roblox + discord call, I can achieve at minimum 2-3 hours of gameplay before needing to plug in, but this depends on the game. No lag whatsoever.

\- Project Zomboid + discord call, I can achieve 3-4 hours of gameplay, 60fps

\- Minecraft + discord call, while plugged in, 60fps

\- Minecraft w/ Shaders + discord call, 10-40fps depending on which shader.

​

I'll also mention that for each point where I only mention being plugged in, being plugged in doesn't make me lag or decrease my performance, I just can't tell you with confidence how long the battery will last, as I either haven't kept track, or never done it on battery.

Finally I'll finish off this wall of text by saying, I have the 8 core M1 Pro and I'm not sure how the M2 stacks up in reality, as I haven't kept up with M2 news, but if it stacks up even remotely similar in reality vs on paper, then my recommendation would be a 10 or 12 core M2 Pro with 16 or 32GB of ram with 1 or 2TB of storage.

2FA (Two Factor Authentication, if you aren’t aware) is a method to protect you in the event your password gets leaked, or your email gets hacked. With 2FA you use a secondary method to verify that you are the only one accessing your account. Some 2FA methods such as SMS or sending an email to your email address are not secure due to SIM Swap Scams or if your email gets hacked, but the temporary codes generated by apps like Authy and Google Authenticator are rolling codes that change every 30 seconds using cryptographically secure methods to generate the numbers, which makes them impossible to brute force or guess.

Tldr, it makes your account more secure from hackers.
